findings.input: notification delivery created before membership revocation
findings.mission: open the inbox after losing household access
findings.expected: former-household notification and target scope are not returned
findings.actual: the inbox previously filtered by userId only
findings.rootCause: NotificationDelivery lacked household/child navigation scope and list authorization did not recheck membership
findings.fix: persist nullable navigation scope, filter by active household membership, and return a server-derived typed navigation object
findings.residualRisk: legacy household-null notifications remain generic and cannot deep-link to protected data

findings.input: browser-created review request and high-risk revision
findings.mission: complete review and publish through Admin
findings.expected: content hash and professional review decision reach the API; safety evidence is explicit
findings.actual: the Admin client omitted contentHash and non-safety professionalReviewConfirmed fields required by the DTO
findings.rootCause: client DTO drift and incomplete high-risk review UI
findings.fix: send revision hash and explicit review flags, add safety evidence controls, and fail high-risk state mismatch with a stable publish-gate error
findings.residualRisk: no external editor or production Admin session

findings.input: paginated Report source after child, household or period change
findings.mission: trace a Report total to matching source rows
findings.expected: aggregate and source share household, child and KST period; full totals differ from page totals
findings.actual: the source contract did not carry householdId or pageTotals
findings.rootCause: source navigation and response contract were narrower than the aggregate scope
findings.fix: add household scope and pageTotals, reject stale source scope, and retain full server totals

findings.input: owner assigns an item plan to another active household member
findings.mission: receive an inbox item and navigate to the assigned preparation item
findings.expected: assignment history and a scoped notification are written atomically
findings.actual: assignment changed the plan but did not create an assignee notification
findings.rootCause: the collaboration mutation and notification outbox were not connected
findings.fix: create NotificationDelivery and outbox records in the item-plan transaction with household, child and target scope

findings.input: auth-required, conflict, retry-exhausted and quarantined rows
findings.mission: understand the highest-priority failure and recover once
findings.expected: distinct state copy, single-flight actions and server-proof-only reconciliation
findings.actual: recovery actions were not uniformly single-flight and quarantine had no explicit recheck action
findings.rootCause: state presentation and controller actions evolved separately
findings.fix: central priority selector, action locks and a safe reconciliation CTA

findings.input: financial or preparation mutation with cached consumers
findings.mission: see only affected-scope updates without a fetch storm
findings.expected: query invalidation is limited to affected scope keys
findings.actual: mutation helpers and expense screens used root-wide invalidation
findings.rootCause: query roots were shared but scope matching was absent
findings.fix: predicate-based scope invalidation and removal of redundant immediate root invalidations
findings.residualRisk: network request count is contract-tested, not device-profiled

findings.input: full API suite with browser specs present
findings.mission: run unit/integration and browser tests under their intended resource policies
findings.expected: browser specs run only in the single-worker browser configuration
findings.actual: default Vitest discovery also included browser specs and caused two 30-second resource timeouts
findings.rootCause: browser include pattern was added without a matching default-suite exclusion
findings.fix: exclude .browser.test.ts from default API tests and retain a dedicated single-worker runner

findings.input: Report source route added after the former 37-route inventory
findings.mission: generate the current route state matrix
findings.expected: scenario count follows the generated route registry
findings.actual: the generator hard-coded 37 routes and 333 cells
findings.rootCause: historical count was treated as an invariant
findings.fix: validate against inventory.counts.routes and compute routeCount times scenarioCount
findings.residualRisk: runtime Android layout qualification remains separate
